targetText: Setting the teakettle on the floor, Grusha embraced Vasya.
explanation: Vassilissa returns to her working-class attic and communal life, finding true emotional security in revolutionary female comradeship.

targetText: Do come in. It's your attic after all. I owe my living here only to you.
explanation: Solidarity among working women: communal living space shared among comrades replaces individualistic property isolation.
